title: Litoral western block 13 outer roof sections
visualBrief: Complete713.0755517970m² outer mapped-building roof section of Litoral western block13, preserving all8derived corners and subtracting the bound accepted roof. This intrinsic section does not complete the whole prison. Exact full2023extent, use, room census and physical interface remain unverified. Original Original OSM building-way WKB and record/hash retained via Overture2026-10-21 under ODbL. Eleven original2023qualified numeric outside points median5m support the section; the learned relative height is not surveyed, and does not verify its whole2023extent. Nominal15m horizontal and3m height modeling allowances are estimates, not measured error bounds. Original material-neighbor floor is chosen after own field and before geometry. All facade, roof profile, materials/openings/finish, grade and2023continuity remain estimates. All appearance imagery unused; Qualla first unrelated portrait excluded. No Google footprint rank or per-building accuracy probability applies to this OSM record. Mapped building extent is not an observed complete roof survey; roof profile, unsampled portions and courtyard relationship remain unverified. Entire complete source-set difference retained with8original derived corners and713.0755517970m² outside the accepted roof. Full original OSM/Overture WKB and bound accepted mask remain unchanged. No site or yard polygon adopted as roof. Eleven original qualified2023height/presence samples median5m support this outer roof section; learned relative height is not survey. Full source geometry is the retained original OSM building-way footprint recorded2023-12-28 and does not verify complete2023roof extent or continuity. No source footprint confidence or measured accuracy applies. Initial absolute floor 13.8954m transferred from material-overlap accepted neighbor after own field, before geometry. Local floor 0.398m is an original interface estimate, not a surveyed vertical tie. Source field/frame/floor and main sections frozen before first render; no grade fitting, masking, flattening, cutout or relocation. Full source roof complement is a closed volume. Doors/window census, bars, canopy, stucco, roof membrane, concrete/foundation and exact roof section are original estimates. Four authored detail levels retain every derived corner and major section; higher levels refine openings/bars. Original15m horizontal/3m height allowances are modeling estimates, not measured error bounds. All source imagery, photos, map pixels, plans and figures unused. Qualla first single unrelated portrait excluded. Source outlines and numeric heights do not establish room function, floor census, surveyed grade, precise historic condition or ownership. No original accepted member geometry, field, floor, pose or QA changed. Whole prison remains unfinished.
